what: Colored panels stick at the same height (90px from top) and stack, covering the previous one in turn, tabs poking above each panel shift sideways one slot at a time, so the tabs of passed panels remain in a row like binder index tabs — for timelines, steps and chronological lists

options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panel to stack (child) — always paint a background (if transparent, the previous panel shows through)
options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Tabs above the panel (child of the panel, optional). The part adds --fx-i (index) and they shift aside
options.--fx-step: Gap between tabs (via style), default clamp(60px, 12.15vw + 14.4px, 170px)
options.min: Applies only at this width or wider (px), default 960 — below that the panels flow one after another

from.where: index.html .g-era-list (five eras — sticky top 90px, tab gap clamp(60px, 12.15vw + 14.4px, 170px), tab height 53px, trapezoid tabs perspective(50px) rotateX(15deg))

note: Pinning is a single CSS sticky, so it doesn’t break even inside an inner scroll panel. Only the last panel must come to the front, so the part gives each panel a z-index in sequence
